title: correction_proposal
description: A proposed fix for a confirmed deviation. Reviewed by a human before anything is applied. Kept deliberately small: output length drives generation time, and this agent runs against a hard request ceiling.

target.description: What gets edited. Follows from the root cause: agent -> prompt, data -> mapping, sow -> sow. Use human only when no edit fixes it and a person must act.

title.description: Short imperative name for the change, under 80 characters.

rationale.description: One sentence on why this prevents recurrence. Not a paragraph.

afterText.description: The complete replacement text, ready to apply — not a description of what to write. This is the only long field; spend the words here.

cmmsAction.description: The CMMS write needed to repair the real-world consequence.

verb.description: none when the correction is purely a prompt, mapping or clause edit. update when a record exists and is wrong. create ONLY when no record exists at all — check cmmsRecord first, since creating a duplicate is the worst outcome here.

recordId.description: The service request id to update. Empty string when verb is create or none.

fields.description: Fields to write, using the CMMS's own vocabulary. Empty when verb is none.

humanTask.description: One sentence naming what a person must do and who owns it, when correcting the cause still leaves real work undone. Specific enough to act on without reading the call. Empty string when no human task is needed.
